listening.title: A first call to a logistics company

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Good morning. This is Nam from TechViet Software. Am I speaking with Ms. Thu, the operations manager?

lines.speaker: Thu (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Yes, this is Thu. What is this about?

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Thank you for taking my call. We help logistics companies track their trucks in real time. I will be brief.

lines.speaker: Thu (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Okay, but I only have a couple of minutes.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Of course. May I ask how your team tracks deliveries at the moment?

lines.speaker: Thu (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Mostly by phone and Excel. To be honest, it takes a lot of time.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Many of our clients had the same problem. Our tool cut their tracking time by half.

lines.speaker: Thu (Operations Manager)
lines.text: That sounds interesting, but I need to see it before I decide anything.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Executive)
lines.text: That is fair. Do you have a free calendar slot on Thursday afternoon for a twenty-minute online demo?

lines.speaker: Thu (Operations Manager)
lines.text: Thursday at three works for me. Please send the invitation to my email.

lines.speaker: Nam (Sales Executive)
lines.text: Great, I will send it right after this call. Thank you, Ms. Thu, and have a nice day.
